2140. Counting the Frequency of a Character in a String

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a word and a character, and count how many times that character appears in the word, using a loop combined with an if statement.

Description
Read a string word into a character array using scanf, followed by a single character ch to search for. Use a loop to examine each character of word up to its null terminator, using an if statement to check whether it matches ch, and increase a counter whenever it does. Print the final count.
input_spec: A word with no spaces, followed by a single character, separated by a space.
output_spec: Print the number of times the character appears in the word.
